036    void bubbleSortInPlace(String[][]songItems, int[] sortedSongsIndexs, int heristic){
037        boolean sorted=false;
038        while (!sorted){
039            boolean roundsorted=true;
040            for (int i =0; i< sortedSongsIndexs.length-1; i++){
041                String w1 = songItems[sortedSongsIndexs[i]][heristic];
042                String w2 = songItems[sortedSongsIndexs[i+1]][heristic];
043                System.out.println(w1+w2);
044                for (int heristicCharacter = 0;heristicCharacter<Math.min(w1.length(), w2.length());heristicCharacter++){
045                    if (w1.charAt(heristicCharacter) < w2.charAt(heristicCharacter)){
046                        break;
047                    }
048                    if (w1.charAt(heristicCharacter) > w2.charAt(heristicCharacter)){
049                        System.out.println("Swapping");
050                        int temp = sortedSongsIndexs[i];
051                        sortedSongsIndexs[i] = sortedSongsIndexs[i+1];
052                        sortedSongsIndexs[i+1] = temp;
053                        roundsorted = false;
054                        break;
055                    }                            
056                }
057
058
059            }
060            sorted = roundsorted;
061        }
062
063    }
064/**
065 * Internal function that gets called when the list of songs needs to be regenerated after sorting on different param.
066 * @param selectedIndex, the attribute of the song to sort betwee
067 * 0-> is the song title, 1-> artist name
068 */
069    void renderSongs(int selectedIndex){
070
071        // center: list of songs
072        ObservableList<String> songItems = FXCollections.observableArrayList();
073
074        // get the raw String[][] from SongList
075        String[][] songs = songList.getSongArray();
076
077        // assuming each song row has [0]=title, [1]=artist
078        sortedSongsIndexs = new int[songs.length];
079        for (int i = 0; i < songs.length; i++) {
080            sortedSongsIndexs[i] = i;
081        }
082
083
084        bubbleSortInPlace(songs, sortedSongsIndexs, selectedIndex);
085
086        for (int i: sortedSongsIndexs){
087            if (songs[i] != null && songs[i][0] != null) {
088                String title = songs[i][0];
089                String artist = songs[i][1];
090                String cost = songs[i][2];
091                String entry = title + " - " + artist+ " - Cost To queue: " + cost +"- Cost to play next: " + (Double.parseDouble(cost) +0.50) ;
092                songItems.add(entry);
093            }
094        }
095
096        songListView = new ListView<>(songItems);
097        root.setCenter(songListView);
098        System.out.println("rendingSong");
099    }
